notes.title: Version 1.4.3 of the game Capybara Achievement Clicker
notes.content:
[h1] Version 1.4.3 of the Game [/h1]

[b] Price changes and new improvements. [/b]


[h3] - Update of certain text in the "I". [/h3]

[b] -> The text of the version and the date. ( 1.3.3 -> 1.4.3 ) [/b]


[h3] - Increase of the particles. [/h3]

[b] -> 41 to 43. [/b]


[h3] - Unique improvements prices for click and click per second is increased. [/h3]

[b] -> Giga Capybara. ( 10.000$ -> 12.000$ ) [/b]
[b] -> Tera Capybara. ( 50.000$ -> 55.000$ ) [/b]
[b] -> Ultimate Capybara. ( 180.000$ -> 240.000$ ) [/b]

[b] -> Mega Auto. ( 7.000$ -> 7.500$ ) [/b]
[b] -> Giga Auto. ( 30.000$ -> 32.000$ ) [/b]


[h3] - 2 new unique upgrades. [/h3]

[b] -> The God Capybara. [/b]
[b] -> And the Radioactive Capybara. [/b]


[h2] Good Game ! [/h2]
